comments.author: AttilaDuran
comments.body_html: Sorry to ask this stupid question , but will it work with the 3.9 ?

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
No - I actually intended to release this weeks ago for 3.9 but the mod is actually impossible to use in prior versions of SPT because it was based on the offline practice mode.

Since SPT is now based on PVE, the item IDs stay the same between raids and restarts…so the mod functions.

TLDR: It will never be compatible with prior SPT versions. Only 3.10+
